definitions.explanation: Vegetables that have not been cooked, served fresh. Common in salads and as side dishes.

examples.japanese: {生野菜|なまやさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: To eat a raw vegetable salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生野菜|なまやさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Raw vegetables go well with grilled meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{毎日|まいにち}{生野菜|なまやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to eat raw vegetables every day for my health.

notes:
{生野菜|なまやさい} is composed of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, uncooked) + ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生野菜|なまやさい}⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: raw vegetable salad
- {生野菜|なまやさい}スティック: vegetable sticks (crudites)

RELATED WORDS WITH {生|なま}:
- ⟦{生|なま}ビール→生ビール：23496_namabiiru⟧: draft beer
- {生|なま}たまご: raw egg
- {生|なま}もの: raw food (especially raw seafood)

USAGE: The prefix ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ is commonly used with food items to indicate they are uncooked or unprocessed. In Japanese cuisine, which traditionally favors cooked vegetables, the practice of eating {生野菜|なまやさい} became widespread with the adoption of Western-style salads.
